machine.definition: A machine is a man-made object with moving parts.
machine.sentence: I'm putting the clothes in the washing machine. Is there anything you want washed?

mad.definition: If someone is mad, they are angry.
mad.sentence: I am so mad at you for ruining my painting.

magazine.definition: A magazine is a publication that is printed regularly (usually weekly or monthly), and is often about a topic like a hobby, sports or news.
magazine.sentence: I get the magazine Cosmopolitan every month. I really like the articles it has on fashion and love.

magic.definition: Magic has to do with making things happen in ways that are not physical, and might be called supernatural.
magic.sentence: The fairy god mother used magic to turn mice into horses.

mail.definition: Mail is the messages and packages that you send to other people.
mail.sentence: There's no mail today because the post office is closed.

main.definition: The main thing is the most important or biggest one.
main.sentence: They turned off the main road and saw a small house.

mainly.definition: For the most part; almost totally.
mainly.sentence: In England, they speak mainly English.

maintain.definition: If you maintain something, you keep it at the same level.
maintain.sentence: Who's more likely to maintain the status quo?

maintenance.definition: Maintenance is the process of regularly fixing things and keeping something in good shape.
maintenance.sentence: Wood houses can be a problem because they require regular maintenance.

major.definition: A major change, problem, event, etc. is a big and important one.
major.sentence: We expected the change to cause a lot of problems, but in the end it wasn't as major as we had thought.

majority.definition: The biggest of several groups of people or things.

make.definition: If you make something, you create it.

maker.definition: A maker is someone who makes stuff.
maker.sentence: Harley Davidson is a maker of motorcycles.

male.definition: A person, animal, or plant that is male produces sperm or pollen. Boys and men are male people.
male.sentence: The male dog is usually larger than the female one.

man.definition: A man is a male human.
man.sentence: He was a young man with blue eyes.

manage.definition: If you manage something, you organise and control it.
manage.sentence: Other European countries manage their health services better than we do.

management.definition: Management is the act of watching and controlling a business or situation.
management.sentence: This building uses a computerized energy management systems to save electricity.

manager.definition: A manager is someone who manages or organizes people or things together.
manager.sentence: Ask the manager of this project. He knows what to do next.

manner.definition: A manner is the way that someone or something acts or performs.
manner.sentence: My daughter quickly changed her manner when I came into her room.

manufacture.definition: If you manufacture something, you make it, usually in a factory.

manufacturer.definition: Manufacturer is a person or company that makes goods for sale.

many.definition: You use many to indicate that you are talking about a large number of people or things.

map.definition: A map is an image of a place, usually with place names written in.
map.sentence: I think we're lost. Do you have a map?

march.definition: A formal, rhythmic way of walking. A march is usually done by soldiers, bands and in ceremonies.

margin.definition: A margin is the space on the sides of a page where there is no writing.
margin.sentence: If you own the book, write notes in the margin.

mark.definition: A mark is a single line left by a pen or pencil, or any small bit of color that got onto something.
mark.sentence: You have a mark on your shirt from that tomato sauce you were eating.

market.definition: A market is a place where many people come to buy and sell things.
market.sentence: It's time to take the cows to the market.

marriage.definition: The life two people have together while they are married.
marriage.sentence: The marriage seemed good until he left her.

marry.definition: If you marry two things, you connect them or make them into one thing.
marry.sentence: I have two different ideas I would like to marry together.

mass.definition: A measure of how much material is in something.
mass.sentence: The Earth has much more mass than the moon.

master.definition: A master is someone who controls something.
master.sentence: She is the master of this domain.

match.definition: A match is a game of football, tennis, etc.
match.sentence: We lost the first match, but hope to win our next two.

mate.definition: A mate is someone you do something with.
mate.sentence: Nils, my tent mate, was from the same elementary school in the city.

material.definition: Material is the things or ideas that are used in making or doing something.
material.sentence: He spent a year researching and gathering material before writing the book.

mathematics.definition: Mathematics is the study of numbers.
mathematics.sentence: Use of addition, subtraction, multiplication and division are part of basic mathematics.

matter.definition: A matter is something that you can talk about or do something about a topic or a situation.
matter.sentence: Government must make these changes as a matter of urgency.

mature.definition: Someone is mature if they act like an adult.
mature.sentence: You're not mature enough to do this job.

maximum.definition: A maximum is the largest or highest value or amount.

may.definition: To be allowed to; to have permission to do something.
may.sentence: He may be lying, but I'm not sure.

maybe.definition: If you say that maybe something will happen or that maybe it is true, you mean there is a chance of those things.
maybe.sentence: Maybe someday I'll learn how to drive.

mayor.definition: A mayor is the government leader of a village, town, or city.
mayor.sentence: Next November, city council and Mayor Arakawa are up for reelection.

meal.definition: A meal is the food you eat at regular times of the day. Breakfast, lunch, supper and dinner, are meals.
meal.sentence: Thanks for dinner! I haven't had a good Italian meal like that for a long time.

mean.definition: A word means something when the word expresses the same idea as the other something.
mean.sentence: You never understand what I mean!

meanwhile.definition: You use meanwhile to introduce a new topic happening at the same time as the old topic.
meanwhile.sentence: International students are here only to study English. Meanwhile, many immigrant students must also work and take care of their families.

measure.definition: If you measure something, you calculate its size, mass, temperature, etc. using units like centimetres, kilograms, degrees, etc.
measure.sentence: Measure the length of the wall.

measurement.definition: Measurement is the act of measuring something.
measurement.sentence: The measurement of flour you need is four cups.

meat.definition: Meat is the muscle of animals that we eat. Beef, chicken, and pork are kinds of meat.
meat.sentence: I am a vegetarian. I don't eat meat, only fruits, grains, and vegetables.

mechanism.definition: A mechanism is the way something works.
mechanism.sentence: These two features combine to create a new data retrieval mechanism.

medical.sentence: Dr. Barry was very creative in his teaching, research, and medical practice.

medicine.definition: Medicine is something you put into or on your body when you are sick to make yourself healthy.
medicine.sentence: The school of medicine at the University of Western Ontario has produced some of the country's best doctors.

medium.definition: A medium amount is an amount that is not small and not large, but in the middle.
medium.sentence: Would you like a small, medium or large drink?

meet.definition: When you meet someone, you get together with them.

member.definition: A member is someone belonging to a group or organization.
member.sentence: I am a member of Simple English Wikipedia.

membership.sentence: I had to renew my membership with the union.

memory.definition: When someone remembers something, we call the thing they remember a memory.
memory.sentence: When we get older, our memory isn't as good.

mental.definition: Mental health, processes etc. is related to the mind and thinking.
mental.sentence: The program helps people deal with drinking, depression and other mental health problems.

mention.definition: If you mention something, you say it or talk about it, but only very briefly.
mention.sentence: Did you mention the changes to Susan?

menu.definition: A menu is a small book for displaying the type of food sold in a restaurant.
menu.sentence: We collected the menu from the waiter after we sat down in the fast food restaurant.

mere.definition: You use mere to show how small or unimportant something is or seems to be.
mere.sentence: Humans sing to express feelings beyond mere words.

merely.definition: If something is merely done, it is done without any other reason.

mess.definition: A mess is a dirty or untidy place or situation.
mess.sentence: Your room is such a mess! You're not leaving the house until you clean it up!

message.definition: A message is information that is sent between living things and is sent from one person to the other. There are some types of message, like phone message and subliminal message.
message.sentence: On his desk there was a message from Jack to call home.

metal.definition: Metal is a hard material, often shiny and easy to conduct electricity. Gold, silver, and steel are examples of metals.
metal.sentence: We replaced out our wood door with a stronger metal one.

method.definition: If you use a method to achieve a goal, then you use a planned process.
method.sentence: My preferred method for contacting friends overseas is on the Internet.

middle.definition: The place that is between two things; the place that is halfway between two ends of something.
middle.sentence: Cut the wood exactly in the middle to get two pieces of equal size.

might.sentence: I might go to the whole party if I were growing up faster this morning.

mile.definition: A mile is a measurement of distance. It is equal to 1.609 km (5280 feet, or 1760 yards).
mile.sentence: It's about a mile and a half to the school.

military.definition: If something is military, it is a characteristic of people in the armed forces.
military.sentence: Sick soldiers go to the military hospital.

milk.definition: Milk is a white liquid some animals make for their babies to drink. People often drink cow's milk.
milk.sentence: The boy had some fresh goat milk.

mind.definition: Someone's mind is the part of them that thinks.
mind.sentence: In my mind I know I must go, but in my heart I want to stay here.

mine.definition: A mine is a large hole in the ground from which rocks and minerals are taken.

minimum.definition: The minimum is the lowest number, size, amount, etc. that exists, that is allowed, or that is possible.
minimum.sentence: Try to keep drinking to a minimum at school.

minister.definition: A minister is a politician who is in charge of a part of the government.
minister.sentence: The Minister of Defense has said that the army will remain in the city for at least two more weeks.

minor.definition: A minor change, problem, injury, etc. is not very important.
minor.sentence: We still have to make a few minor changes, but it's mostly done.

minority.definition: A minority is less than half (50%) of some group.
minority.sentence: Most people agreed, but a sizable minority were upset by the decision.

minute.definition: A minute is a short time equal to sixty seconds. There are sixty minutes in one hour.
minute.sentence: Please wait a minute while I get my coat and then I will come with you.

mirror.definition: A very reflective surface which light can bounce off of.
mirror.sentence: She kept staring at the mirror all day.

miss.definition: If you miss something, you don't hit it.
miss.sentence: I miss you so much. When are you coming home?

mission.definition: A mission is a quest given by someone to gain something.

mistake.definition: A mistake is something that is done wrong or is incorrect.
mistake.sentence: It's a mistake to think that everyone wants the same things.

mix.definition: If you mix something, you stir two or more things together.
mix.sentence: Mix the eggs and milk with the flour.

mixture.definition: A mixture is two or more things that have been mixed together; it is a mix.

mobile.definition: A mobile is a small device that can be used to call someone.

mode.definition: A mode is a specific way of doing something.
mode.sentence: The machine is in warm-up mode right now.

model.definition: A model is a something that is made to look or act like something else, usually being smaller or simpler than the original.
model.sentence: Scientists have developed a theoretical model of the planet's interior that describes one possibility.

moderate.definition: If someone or something is moderate, it is balanced and not extreme.
moderate.sentence: The weather in Hawai'i tends to be quite moderate.

modern.definition: If something is modern, it happened in current times.
modern.sentence: The new house has all modern conveniences.

modify.definition: If you modify something, you change it, often only in small ways, and often because you want to use it in a different situation.
modify.sentence: Both penalties and rewards can be used to modify children's behaviour.

module.definition: A module is a part of a system. It can often be changed at any time.

moment.definition: A moment is a very short time. It is not an exact measurement.
moment.sentence: Geraldine sat on the bed and thought for a moment.

money.definition: Money is the coins or notes that are used to pay for things.
money.sentence: You don't want to spend your money on an ice cream. You can buy something else.

monitor.definition: A monitor is part of a computer or other similar machine, and it looks like a TV.
monitor.sentence: The engineers stood around the monitor making suggesting about how the drawing could be improved.

month.definition: A measure of time, approximately equal to the time taken for the moon to circle the earth.
month.sentence: He paid the bill last month.

monthly.definition: If something is monthly, then it happens or comes once in a month.

mood.definition: An emotion or a state of mind.
mood.sentence: The national mood had changed radically since the last election.

moon.definition: A moon is a thing like a small planet that goes around another planet.
moon.sentence: I was able to see the road because there was a full moon that night.

moral.definition: A moral action or decision is one that is good or right not evil or harmful.
moral.sentence: John, don't do that, it's not very moral.

more.definition: Used to form the comparative of some adjectives and adverbs, indicates that the adjective or adverb is more of something.

moreover.definition: You use morever to show that there is another connected idea.
moreover.sentence: The cellar was dark; moreover, mice nested there.

morning.sentence: I spent the morning running errands.

mortgage.definition: A mortgage is a loan for the purpose of paying for a house, apartment, building, etc.
mortgage.sentence: They can't refinance because the mortgage is higher than the real value of their home.

most.definition: Having the largest amount of a characteristic in a group.
most.sentence: You must ask yourself what is most important.

mostly.definition: If something is mostly true, empty, sunny, etc., it is close to 100% so.

mother.definition: A mother is the woman who is one of a person or animal's parents.
mother.sentence: My mother read me a story and put me to bed every night when I was a child.

motion.definition: A motion is a movement, often not a big movement.
motion.sentence: She made a small motion with her hand to get his attention.

motivate.definition: If you motivate someone, then you make them want to do something.
motivate.sentence: The guest speaker went to the school to help motivate the students.

motivation.definition: Someone's motivation is their feeling that they want to do something.
motivation.sentence: Students' motivation is falling because the lessons are not interesting.

motor.definition: A machine that changes energy into motion (movement).
motor.sentence: Happiness is the aim of all men and the motor of all action.

mount.definition: If you mount something you get on to it.
mount.sentence: I need someone to mount this diamond on a ring.

mountain.definition: A natural rise of the Earth's surface having considerable mass.
mountain.sentence: We visited that mountain last year. The scenery was beautiful.

mouse.definition: A mouse is a very small animal that is similar to a small rat.
mouse.sentence: The mouse ran across the room.

mouth.definition: A part of the face used for eating and talking.
mouth.sentence: He opened his mouth to speak.

move.definition: If you move, you go from one place to another.
move.sentence: I was so afraid, I couldn't move.

movement.definition: Movement is the act of moving, of changing place or position.
movement.sentence: The European Union allows free movement of people between countries.

movie.definition: A movie is a motion picture that tells a story and is shown on a screen or television.
movie.sentence: That was a really good movie as the story was interesting.

much.definition: To a great degree or extent.

multiple.definition: Multiple items are more than one item.
multiple.sentence: We ran into multiple problems, but we solved them all.

muscle.definition: A muscle is a part of the body of a person or animal. It's a part that pulls to make parts of the body move.
muscle.sentence: The senators used their muscle to get the party leader to resign.

museum.definition: A museum is a building where pictures, sculptures and other arts are shown.

music.definition: Sounds that are played on musical instruments or sung with a certain rhythm and harmony, and forming melodies.
music.sentence: You cannot make any music with this trumpet, it is broken.

musical.definition: If something is musical it makes music or is about music.
musical.sentence: A drum is a musical instrument.

musician.definition: A musician is a person who makes music. Most often, this is someone whose job is to make music for other people.
musician.sentence: My cousin is a musician for an orchestra in Texas.

must.definition: Must is usually used to tell someone they have no choice about doing something because it is important or because of a rule or law.
must.sentence: I must have left my phone at the restaurant.

mutual.definition: If something is mutual x does it to y, and y does it to x.
mutual.sentence: The working relationship between the two men was based on a mutual respect.

mystery.definition: A mystery is a secret or hidden matter which can't be explained.
mystery.sentence: She never told me where the money was, and it remains a mystery to me even now.
